newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslavia holds 1997 wheat forecast at 2.8. mln T.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslavia holds 1997 wheat forecast at 2.8. mln T.

text.p: The latest forecast for Yugoslavia's 1997 wheat crop was unchanged at 2.8 million tonnes, 1.3 million tonnes more than last year, Federal Statistics Office said in a report.
The report was based on the state of the crops on June 20. Its previous forecast was based on crop evaluation on May 31.
This year's wheat area of some 802,000 hectares is 219,000 ha up on the area harvested last year.
The estimated average yield of some 3.44 tonnes per ha is up by some 858 kg on last year's average.
Last year's wheat harvest dropped to a 25-year low of just 1.51 million tonnes from 2.97 million in 1995.

Government officials expect the wheat crop to reach three million tonnes this year. This will meet domestic needs and, weather permitting, leave some 500,000 tonnes for export. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsrom 381 11 311 4305
